description: Read how each of Yutai's data sources stands today, with a plain sentence for its mode, beside the answer's version, the build and its instant.
name: get_status

status.description: How the service stands: ok when it answers, degraded when part of it is unavailable, down when a check failed; a down word stands up to thirty seconds, so a recovered service can answer down briefly.

time.description: The instant this answer was made, in the ISO 8601 form.

version.description: The build this answer comes from: the first seven characters of the source commit, or unknown when the serving environment names none.

title: Get status
